name: ithmb-codec-web
description: Free private browser-based .ithmb (Apple iThumbnail) file decoder.

scripts.test:quick: playwright test tests/pages.spec.ts tests/ithmb-decoder.spec.ts tests/gallery.spec.ts tests/upload.spec.ts tests/quality.spec.ts tests/a11y.spec.ts tests/seo-metadata.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.ci: bun run lint:modules && bun run lint:i18n && playwright test
scripts.build:pages: rm -rf _site && bun run build && mkdir _site && tar --exclude='./node_modules' --exclude='./.git' --exclude='./.github' --exclude='./_site' --exclude='./test-results' --exclude='./preview' --exclude='./CNAME' -cf - . | tar -xf - -C _site
scripts.lint:modules: bun run typecheck && bun run build

author: ITHMB Codec
